statement: The upstream ds4 main worktree builds clean at 9ab7053, the current upstream main (fetched from antirez/ds4). `make` produces ds4-bench, ds4-server, ds4-eval, and ds4-agent. This is the main arm for the Q8-vs-main comparison GiorgioOppo asked about: the Q8 build is f309990, and main is 9ab7053. The build is a plain `make` (cc -O3 -ffast-math -g -mcpu=native, Metal framework on Darwin), no special flags. A smoke test ran ds4-bench --help and it exited 0, so the binary runs. The build itself is recorded in provenance.binaries; the claims below are the read-only checks that still hold.

claims.statement: The ds4-main-b worktree is at 9ab7053, the current upstream main fetched from antirez/ds4. The existing ds4-main worktree is also at 9ab7053, so this build is at the same rev as the peer's main worktree.
claims.falsifier: If the ds4-main-b worktree is not at 9ab7053, then this build is not the main arm the comparison needs.

claims.statement: The four built binaries have the recorded sizes: ds4-bench 2263560, ds4-server 2623768, ds4-eval 2432968, ds4-agent 2547544 bytes. The build produced all four.
